payload.summaryOriginal: Ask AI about your FiTin logs

payload.name: PB-Runner Running Coach
payload.description: AI running coach for your runs
payload.summaryOriginal: AI running coach for your runs

payload.name: Skyscanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare and book cheap flights from anywhere, to everywhere. 

We scan all the top airlines and travel providers, so you can compare flight fares and other travel costs in one place. Once you’ve found the best flight, you book directly with the provider.
payload.longDescription:
比较并预订从世界各地出发、前往任意目的地的低价航班。

我们会搜索各大航空公司和旅行服务商，让你在一处比较机票价格和其他旅行费用。找到心仪航班后，你可以直接向服务商预订。

payload.name: FlightPoints
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlightPoints helps travelers search award availability across airline loyalty programs, compare points prices, filter by cabin and routing preferences, and inspect flight segments. Search cached availability without signing in, or link a FlightPoints account to request live results. FlightPoints can open booking handoff links but does not complete bookings or accept payment.
payload.longDescription: FlightPoints 搜索各航空忠诚度计划的奖励票库存，比较积分价格并按舱位和航线筛选；可匿名搜索缓存或连接账户获取实时结果。可打开预订交接链接，但不完成预订或收款。

payload.name: trivago
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The trivago MCP server lets users search for hotels and other accommodations by travel dates and location, from countries and cities to specific venues, landmarks, or other points of interest. Using the details provided, it returns tailored hotel options with prices from multiple booking sites, plus photos, key accommodation details, and helpful links to learn more. In simple terms, it gives AI assistants an efficient way to help users find the right stay at the right price.

You can use the trivago app for 

Search hotels by destination and dates:
"Find me a hotel in Las Vegas for 2 people from 12 July to 20 July 2026"

Find budget accommodation near landmarks:
"I need a cheap accommodation near the Eiffel Tower for 1 night the 12th of June 2026"

Book hotels near event venues:
"Find me a hotel near the Etihad Stadium for 12 July to 14 July 2026"

Coordinate travel with conferences:
"I need accommodation close to the venue of the next KubeCon happening in Europe in 2026"

Plan family vacations:
"I am searching for 2 rooms for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 10 in Barcelona for Easter 2026"
payload.longDescription:
trivago MCP 服务器允许用户根据旅行日期和地点搜索酒店及其他住宿，范围从国家、城市，到具体场馆、地标或其他兴趣点。它会依据提供的详情返回定制酒店选项和多个预订网站的价格，以及照片、住宿关键信息和实用详情链接。简而言之，它为 AI 助手提供高效方式，帮助用户以合适价格找到合适住宿。

你可以使用 trivago 应用来

按目的地和日期搜索酒店：
“帮我找一家 Las Vegas 的酒店，2 人入住，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 20 日”

在地标附近寻找经济型住宿：
“我需要 Eiffel Tower 附近的便宜住宿，住 1 晚，日期是 2026 年 6 月 12 日”

预订活动场馆附近的酒店：
“帮我找一家 Etihad Stadium 附近的酒店，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 14 日”

协调会议差旅：
“我需要住在 2026 年于 Europe 举办的下一届 KubeCon 会场附近”

规划家庭假期：
“我想在 2026 年 Easter 期间入住 Barcelona，订 2 间客房，住 2 位成人和 2 位分别为 6 岁和 10 岁的儿童”

payload.name: Turkish Airlines
payload.description: 搭乘 Turkish Airlines 出行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and book your Turkish Airlines flights directly in ChatGPT. See real-time flight status, compare fares across cabin classes, and then continue to turkishairlines.com to securely complete your booking. You can also look up existing reservations with your PNR or e-ticket number, check baggage allowances, explore city guides, and browse promotional offers.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中规划并预订 Turkish Airlines 航班。查看实时航班状态，比较不同舱位的票价，然后前往 turkishairlines.com 安全完成预订。你也可以使用 PNR 或电子客票号码查询现有预订、查看行李额度、浏览城市指南和促销优惠。

payload.name: komoot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Komoot helps people discover inspiring outdoor adventures!
Explore routes and community-recommended highlights for cycling, hiking, running, and more, shared by a global community of outdoor enthusiasts.
payload.longDescription:
komoot 帮助人们发现精彩的户外探险！
探索全球户外爱好者社区分享的骑行、徒步、跑步等路线及社区推荐的亮点地点。

payload.name: Trip.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and compare flights, hotels, trains, attractions directly in ChatGPT with Trip.com, your all-in-one travel companion. Explore one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights; select hotels in your target cities; pick suitable rail journeys across Europe and Asia, also discover attractions, tickets, tours, experiences, and other things to do with flexible search, filtering, and sorting!

Trip.com is perfect for your journey inspiration, itinerary planning, and travel product booking. Enjoy secure instant booking, and 24/7 support with multiple languages.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接搜索和比较航班、酒店、火车及景点，Trip.com 是你的全方位旅行助手。探索单程、往返和多城市航班；选择目的地城市的酒店；挑选适合的欧洲和亚洲铁路行程；还可通过灵活的搜索、筛选和排序发现景点、门票、旅行团、体验活动及其他可做的事情！

Trip.com 适合获取旅行灵感、规划行程和预订旅行产品。享受安全即时预订和每周 7 天、每天 24 小时的多语言支持。

payload.name: Flight Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Flight Network ChatGPT app to find and compare real-time flight options directly in your chat.                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Simply type @Flight Network followed by your request, or ask for flight recommendations during any travel planning conversation. Example: "Find flights from NYC to London in two weeks"                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Real-Time Data: Access live pricing and availability from hundreds of airlines instantly.                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Conversational Search: No complex filters. Just tell Flight Network ChatGPT app where you want to go and when.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Flight Network 的 ChatGPT 应用，直接在聊天中查找并比较实时航班选项。

只需输入 @Flight Network 并接上你的需求，或在任何旅行规划对话中询问航班建议。例如：“查找两周后从 NYC 飞往 London 的航班。”

实时数据：即时获取数百家航空公司的实时价格和可用情况。

对话式搜索：无需复杂筛选条件。只需告诉 Flight Network ChatGPT 应用你想去哪里、何时出发。

payload.name: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate
payload.description: 查找和探索地点与位置
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fantastic way to use maps with ChatGPT!

Ask it to display the map for somewhere, then scroll and zoom around. Discuss the visible area with ChatGPT, drop pins, and ask questions.

e.g. 

- "Open an interactive @AnyWhereMap"
- "Show me New York City in an interactive @AnyWhereMap"

Open the map, scroll to an area and ask:

- "What is in this area?"
- "Is this a nice place to visit?"
payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起使用地图的精彩方式！

请它显示某个地方的地图，然后滚动并缩放。与 ChatGPT 讨论可见区域、放置标记并提问。

例如：

- “打开交互式 @AnyWhereMap”
- “在交互式 @AnyWhereMap 中显示纽约市”

打开地图，滚动到某个区域，然后问：

- “这个区域有什么？”
- “这里适合游玩吗？”

payload.name: Expedia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip with Expedia, right inside ChatGPT — an easy way to research and compare travel in everyday language. Ask for flights or hotels and see real-time prices, availability, and photos in the conversation. You can now link your Expedia account in ChatGPT to unlock member deals and personalized recommendations.
• Search flights and hotels worldwide
• Compare prices and view hotels on a map
• Explore destinations and plan where to stay
When you're ready, continue on Expedia to book and earn One Key rewards.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Expedia 规划下一次旅行——用日常语言研究和比较旅行选项，轻松方便。询问航班或酒店，即可在对话中查看实时价格、空房情况和照片。现在还可以在 ChatGPT 中关联 Expedia 账户，获取会员优惠和个性化推荐。
• 搜索全球航班和酒店
• 比较价格并在地图上查看酒店
• 探索目的地并规划住宿地点
准备好后，可前往 Expedia 继续预订并赚取 One Key 奖励。

payload.name: Booking.com
payload.summaryOriginal: Find all best stays and more.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore millions of stays, unforgettable attractions and find the ideal rental car for your next getaway, directly with Booking.com on ChatGPT.

- Discover hotels, homes, and everything in between.
- Get great cars at great prices.
- Find must-see attractions and experiences.

Something caught your eye? Tap "View on Booking.com" to book your stay, rental car or attraction today.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过ChatGPT中的Booking.com探索数百万个住宿选项和令人难忘的景点，并为下一次度假找到理想的租赁汽车。

- 探索酒店、住宅和各类住宿。
- 以优惠价格租到优质汽车。
- 查找必看景点和体验。

看到心仪的选项？点击“在Booking.com上查看”，立即预订住宿、租赁汽车或景点。

payload.name: Wikiloc
payload.description: 只需开口，找到理想路线
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

Ask for hiking routes near your destination, cycling paths that match your fitness level, or hidden trails locals love. Explore interactive trail maps with waypoints marking peaks, waterfalls, viewpoints, and other highlights mapped by the Wikiloc community. 

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "Find me family-friendly trails in Spain"
- "Show me mountain bike routes in the Alps around 20km"
- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"
- "I want to see the great cliffs of Ireland. Recommend me some hikes"
- "Show me some stunning hikes ideal for a weekend in California"
payload.longDescription:
描述你想去哪里以及想做什么，无需再费力搜索。你可以从 Wikiloc 的 77 million 条真实路线中获得量身定制的精选路线；这些路线由全球 20 million 名户外爱好者分享。

询问目的地附近的徒步路线、符合你体能水平的骑行路线，或当地人喜爱的隐秘小径。探索互动路线地图，查看 Wikiloc 社区标注的山峰、瀑布、观景点和其他亮点。

查看沿途拍摄的 140 million 多张照片，提前了解景色，为下一次探险做好计划。

可以试着询问：

- “帮我找西班牙适合家庭的路线”
- “给我看看阿尔卑斯山附近约 20km 的山地自行车路线”
- “我下周要去意大利。帮我找多洛米蒂附近 3 条可以欣赏湖景的优美徒步路线”
- “我想看看爱尔兰壮观的悬崖。给我推荐几条徒步路线”
- “给我推荐一些适合在加利福尼亚度过周末的绝美徒步路线”

payload.name: MakeMyTrip
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店和出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover flights, hotels and cabs with real time inventory and pricing right inside your conversation.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中直接查询实时库存和价格，发现航班、酒店和出租车。

payload.name: Travel Vibes: Trip Itineraries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Travel 101 helps you plan trips by turning your preferences into full itineraries. Get a day-by-day plan with flights, accommodation, activities, budget, maps, and more. Save and edit your itinerary in Scratchpad, and share it with travel buddies. No forms or rigid templates, just describe your vibe and get a ready-to-use plan.
payload.longDescription: Travel 101通过将您的偏好转化为完整行程安排，帮助您规划旅行。获取包含航班、住宿、活动、预算、地图等的每日详细计划。在Scratchpad中保存和编辑行程，并与旅行伙伴分享。无需填写表单或使用固定模板，只需描述您的风格即可获得即用型计划。

payload.name: TABLEALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.
payload.longDescription:
TABLEALL 通过 ChatGPT 帮助旅行者和食客在日本各地发现并预订高级餐厅。用户可以按地区、区域或菜系搜索，查看实时空位、套餐菜单和价格、取消政策，并创建预订或预订请求。

TABLEALL 支持米其林星级餐厅以及多种菜系，包括寿司、怀石料理、天妇罗、和牛、法国菜、意大利菜等。返回付款链接后，可在 TableAll 网站上安全完成付款。

payload.name: Gondola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gondola helps users search hotels, flights, and rental cars, compare rates and loyalty value, review trips and travel preferences, manage rate alerts, and follow checkout links to book travel.
payload.longDescription: Gondola帮助用户搜索酒店、航班和租车，比较价格和忠诚度价值，回顾行程和旅行偏好，管理价格警报，并通过结账链接预订旅行。

payload.name: ForeFlight Mobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your ForeFlight data, in conversation. Ask for weather, NOTAMs, and forecasts for any airport. Get route and altitude recommendations with real performance data. Review or log flights, check currency, and manage your logbook - all through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中使用你的 ForeFlight 数据。查询任意机场的天气、NOTAM 航行通告和预报。获取基于真实性能数据的航线和高度建议。通过 ChatGPT 查看或记录飞行、检查飞行资质有效状态并管理飞行日志。

payload.name: eDreams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation.
Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.
payload.longDescription:
无需再为比较几十个标签页而烦恼。eDreams 让你通过简单对话，在一个地方搜索和比较航班与酒店。
只需告诉它你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会迅速展示最便宜且合适的选项，帮助你更快做出决定。

payload.name: Kiwi.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for flights with flexible options around dates, nearby airports, baggage, and stops. 
Discover cheaper routes through virtual interlining (combining flights from different airlines that don't normally connect).
Explore destinations with "anywhere" searches or browse multiple options on an interactive map.
Get full itineraries with pricing, schedules, and booking links - all within the chat.
payload.longDescription:
搜索航班时可灵活调整日期、附近机场、行李和中途停留选项。
通过虚拟联程（组合通常不会衔接的不同航空公司航班）探索更便宜的路线。
使用“任意地点”搜索探索目的地，或在交互式地图上浏览多个选项。
直接在聊天中获取完整行程、价格、时刻表和预订链接。

payload.name: Wego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.
payload.longDescription:
Wego 帮助你在 ChatGPT 中找到价格优惠的机票和酒店。我们会搜索 700+ 个旅游网站，提供准确且极具竞争力的价格，并通过清晰、美观、易懂的界面展示结果。

使用常见筛选条件比较并细化结果。查找航班时，可按航空公司、出发时间及其他重要条件筛选，快速找到合适的行程。查找酒店时，可按住宿类型、星级、位置、价格范围和设施缩小选择范围，更快找到合适的住宿。

全球有 83M+ 旅行者信赖 Wego；它在 iOS App Store 上获得 4.7 评分，在 Google Play 上获得 4.5 评分。需要帮助？我们的 24/7 支持服务会为你接通真人客服。

payload.name: Ryanair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

**What you can do:**
- Search for destinations,  one-way or return flights by destination and date
- Browse available flights with fare information
- Get redirected to Ryanair's website to finalise your booking securely

No more clicking through multiple pages to find what you need. Just describe your trip and get straight to the relevant results.

*Booking and payment are completed directly on Ryanair.com. This assistant helps you find and select flights — it does not process payments or store personal data.*
payload.longDescription:
通过对话界面，更快查找并预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助手你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会搜索可用航线、显示带价格的航班选项，并直接引导你前往瑞安航空网站完成预订。

**你可以：**
- 按目的地和日期搜索目的地、单程或往返航班
- 浏览可用航班及票价信息
- 跳转到瑞安航空网站，安全完成预订

无需再逐页点击查找所需信息。只需描述行程，即可直接查看相关结果。

*预订和付款均直接在 Ryanair.com 完成。此助手帮助你查找和选择航班，不处理付款，也不存储个人数据。*

payload.name: World Airfares
payload.description: 搜索航班，点击即可预订
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

Browse results by recommended picks, airline, or all available options. Filter by travel dates, cabin class, and passengers. Each result shows full flight details including stops, duration, baggage, and pricing. When you're ready, tap Book Now to go straight to the booking page.

Built on the World Airfares API, this app covers one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries across hundreds of airlines worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
World Airfares Flight Search 将实时航班搜索直接带入 ChatGPT 对话。只需告诉 ChatGPT 目的地和出行时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果，无需切换应用或来回打开标签页。

可按推荐选项、航空公司或所有可用选项浏览结果，并按出行日期、舱位和乘客人数筛选。每项结果都会显示完整航班详情，包括经停、时长、行李和价格。准备好后，点击“立即预订”即可前往预订页面。

该应用基于 World Airfares API，可搜索全球数百家航空公司的单程、往返和多城市行程。

payload.name: Bolt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bolt Rides helps riders compare current or scheduled ride estimates, and open Bolt to complete their booking.
payload.longDescription: Bolt Rides 帮助乘客比较即时或预约行程的预估费用，并打开 Bolt 完成预订。

payload.name: GuruWalk: Tours & Activities
payload.description: 查找并预订旅行团与门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

Just say where you're going and when. Each tour comes with its photo, real traveller ratings, the language it's run in, how long it lasts and the times still available for your dates, so you can compare options in one place.

GuruWalk doesn't charge you or complete the booking here. It takes you straight to the tour page on guruwalk.com to finish there, and it can answer the practical questions first: how cancellation works, where the meeting point is, or how to book for a group, using GuruWalk's official support guides.
payload.longDescription:
通过 GuruWalk 探索任意城市。这是全球最大的免费步行游平台。参加免费团无需预先付费，结束时可按自己认为的体验价值向导付费。GuruWalk 还在 1,000 多座城市提供导览、一日游和免排队门票，覆盖马德里、罗马、东京、布宜诺斯艾利斯和纽约等地。

只需说明目的地和出行时间。每个行程都附有照片、真实旅客评分、讲解语言、时长，以及所选日期仍可参加的时段，方便你集中比较。

GuruWalk 不会在此向你收费或完成预订，而会直接带你前往 guruwalk.com 的行程页面完成预订。你也可以先根据 GuruWalk 官方支持指南了解实用信息，例如取消规则、集合地点或团体预订方式。

payload.name: Tripadvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe. They can refine results naturally through conversational follow-ups, access rich hotel details including traveler photos, recent reviews, amenities, compare price offers and click out seamlessly to booking partners or Tripadvisor for deeper research.
payload.longDescription: Tripadvisor 应用将可信评价和酒店信息带入 ChatGPT，让你更快速、更有把握地找到理想住宿。旅行者可通过以地图为主的交互视图浏览高评分酒店，立即了解街区、距离和氛围。你可以通过自然语言追问来优化结果，查看丰富的酒店详情（包括旅行者照片、近期评价和设施），比较价格选项，并顺畅跳转至预订合作伙伴或 Tripadvisor 深入了解。

payload.name: GetYourGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unforgettable travel experiences with GetYourGuide. Discover over 75,000 tours, activities, and attractions worldwide—all in one app.

Plan your trip with ease—build your itinerary, find inspiration, and organize everything in one place. Whether you’re booking ahead or looking for last-minute ideas, explore experiences across culture, food, adventure, nature, and more.

From iconic landmarks like the Colosseum and Eiffel Tower to hidden local gems, we help you make the most of every destination. Enjoy expert-guided tours in cities like Paris, Dubai, New York, Berlin, and beyond—with insider access and flexible booking options.
payload.longDescription:
通过 GetYourGuide 探索难忘的旅行体验。在一个应用中发现全球超过 75,000 项旅行团、活动和景点。

轻松规划行程——制定旅行安排、寻找灵感并在一处整理所有内容。无论你是提前预订还是临时寻找点子，都可以探索文化、美食、冒险、自然等各类体验。

从罗马斗兽场和埃菲尔铁塔等标志性地标，到鲜为人知的本地宝藏，我们帮助你充分体验每个目的地。你可以在巴黎、迪拜、纽约、柏林等城市参加专家导览，并享有内部体验和灵活的预订选项。

payload.name: AI Trip Planner
payload.description: 创建内容丰富的自定义地图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your chat ideas, travel plans, PDFs and TikTok videos into interactive maps with pins, photos, and directions. Use it for trips, city guides, food crawls, campus tours, and more. 

How it works:
Simply plan your trip with ChatGPT as usual and then ask ChatGPT to Mapify your plans to generate an interactive map with pins, photos, and directions. Attach PDFs of travel content and links to TikTok videos to automatically extract locations and build your maps.
payload.longDescription:
将聊天想法、旅行计划、PDF 和 TikTok 视频转化为带地点标记、照片和路线指引的交互式地图。适用于旅行、城市指南、美食探索、校园游览等。

使用方法：
照常使用 ChatGPT 规划旅行，然后让 ChatGPT 将计划 Mapify，生成带地点标记、照片和路线指引的交互式地图。附上旅行内容 PDF 和 TikTok 视频链接，即可自动提取地点并构建地图。

payload.name: Archipelago Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right stay for every journey with Archipelago Hotels. Search hotels, compare options, and check real-time availability directly within ChatGPT.

Discover trusted brands including Aston, fave hotel, Hotel Neo, Harper, The Alana, Quest Hotels, and Kamuela Villas: each offering a unique hospitality experience for business travel, family vacations, city breaks, and resort getaways.

Whether you're planning ahead or looking for a last-minute stay, Archipelago Hotels makes it easy to explore hotels, compare options, and find accommodations that fit your travel needs.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Archipelago Hotels，为每次旅程找到合适的住宿。直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索酒店、比较选项，并查看实时可订情况。

探索 Aston、fave hotel、Hotel Neo、Harper、The Alana、Quest Hotels 和 Kamuela Villas 等值得信赖的品牌：每个品牌都为商务出行、家庭度假、城市短途旅行和度假村休闲提供独特的待客体验。

无论你是提前规划，还是临时寻找住宿，Archipelago Hotels 都能让你轻松探索酒店、比较选项，并找到符合出行需求的住处。

payload.name: Trainline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Making travel plans? Connect Trainline to check trains across the UK and Europe. 
Try asking "Trainline, how much are morning trains from London to Manchester this Saturday?"  
 
We'll show you departures and prices in a clear timetable, so you can pick something that suits your schedule and your budget. "View more on Trainline" when you’re ready to book.  
 
Have a safe and pleasant journey!
payload.longDescription:
正在规划旅行吗？连接 Trainline，查询英国和欧洲各地的火车。
试着问：“Trainline，这周六从 London 到 Manchester 的早班火车多少钱？”

我们会以清晰的时刻表显示出发班次和价格，方便你选择符合日程和预算的车次。准备预订时，点击“在 Trainline 查看更多”。

祝你旅途平安愉快！
